items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: I don't want to hear no Ma Rainey Maurania and all that bunch.

ctx.x: Now, when you say you can get a lot of education from the blues, what do you mean?

Well, if you got it musically, it will show up, if you can play the blues. Wire brushes, sticks, things like that. If you can't the blues, then you might as well forget it and go try to get in the longhair company. Then you have to go to great musical schools and all of that, and get acquainted with that, and start playing in the schools' orchestras. In other words, get your training. You got to start all over again.

Blues, you get your longhair come in a band going to sit there and try to fake a blues solo or something, he doesn't fit. Doesn't fit. Now, Tommy Dorsey can do it, but he still bash'n't got that spook in there. I mean, that down home, old fashioned blues, which is ignorant music to me. I don't want to hear no Ma Rainey Maurania and all that bunch. I want to hear somebody, when they sing the blues, sing the blues.
